# Luxury Society

> > Global insights and analysis for the luxury industry, covering brand strategy, digital transformation, and market trends with a focus on China and major luxury conglomerates like LVMH.

Luxury Society is a leading knowledge platform providing strategic insights for luxury industry professionals. The site features expert analysis on digital marketing, consumer behavior, brand management, and market dynamics, with particular emphasis on the Chinese luxury market, WeChat strategies, and the evolving relationship between heritage brands and digital innovation.

## Key Topics

- China luxury market
- LVMH and luxury conglomerates
- Digital luxury marketing
- WeChat and social media strategy
- Brand strategy and positioning
- Consumer behavior trends
- Luxury e-commerce
- Market volatility and crisis management
- Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Bulgari
- WeChat Luxury Index
- Influencer marketing
- Private domain strategy
- Generational shifts (Post-90s consumers)
- Cultural capital and luxury
- Digital transformation

## China Luxury Market Strategy

- [The Generational Shift of the Luxury Market in China](https://luxurysociety.com/en/generational-shift-luxury-market-china): Post-90s consumers drive China's luxury market generational transition
- [China's Traditional Gifting Culture Gets a Digital Upgrade](https://luxurysociety.com/en/chinas-traditional-gifting-culture-gets-digital-upgrade): Luxury brands leverage WeChat Mini Programs for digital gifting in China
- [Hainan, Hong Kong or Paris: Where Will Chinese Shoppers Go?](https://luxurysociety.com/en/hainan-hong-kong-or-paris-where-will-chinese-shoppers-go): Post-COVID Chinese luxury consumption patterns across Hainan, HK & Paris
- [Why Are Brands Developing Their Private Domains in China?](https://luxurysociety.com/en/why-are-brands-developing-their-private-domains-in-china): Private domain strategy for luxury brands in China's digital landscape
- [Guide to 7 Major Luxury E-commerce Platforms in China](https://luxurysociety.com/zh/%e6%82%a8%e9%9c%80%e8%a6%81%e4%ba%86%e8%a7%a3%e7%9a%84%e4%b8%ad%e5%9b%bd7%e5%a4%a7%e5%a5%a2%e4%be%88%e5%93%81%e7%94%b5%e5%ad%90%e5%95%86%e5%8a%a1%e5%b9%b3%e5%8f%b0): Guide to 7 major luxury e-commerce platforms in China market
- [Top 10 Fashion Bloggers Shaping China's Luxury Industry](https://luxurysociety.com/zh/%e5%a1%91%e9%80%a0%e4%b8%ad%e5%9b%bd%e5%a5%a2%e4%be%88%e5%93%81%e8%a1%8c%e4%b8%9a%e7%9a%8410%e5%a4%a7%e6%97%b6%e5%b0%9a%e5%8d%9a%e4%b8%bb): Top 10 fashion bloggers shaping China's luxury industry landscape

## Digital Marketing & Social Media

- [Luxury Brands Are Moving Into Online Stealth Mode. But How Can They Measure Success?](https://luxurysociety.com/en/luxury-brands-are-moving-into-online-stealth-mode-but-how-can-they-measure-success): Bottega Veneta's social media exit & measuring digital exclusivity success
- [Content Production Remains The Biggest Challenge for Luxury Brands on Douyin](https://luxurysociety.com/en/content-production-remains-biggest-challenge-luxury-brands-douyin): Luxury brands like Balenciaga tackle short video content on Douyin/TikTok
- [Digital Fashion Shows & Social Media Strategy Post-COVID](https://luxurysociety.com/en/social-media-show-must-go-on): Digital fashion shows & social media strategy for Gucci, Loewe post-COVID
- [How Caran d'Ache's Influencer Campaign Helped It To Connect To A New Generation](https://luxurysociety.com/en/how-caran-daches-influencer-campaign-helped-connect-brand-new-generation): Swiss stationery brand Caran d'Ache reaches millennials via influencers
- [Word of Mouth: The Best Marketing](https://luxurysociety.com/en/word-of-mouththe-best-marketing): Lloyd Princeton on word-of-mouth marketing & customer advocacy strategies

- [Longchamp CEO Jean Cassegrain: "We Need To Continue To Stay Relevant."](https://luxurysociety.com/en/longchamp-ceo-jean-cassegrain-we-need-to-continue-to-stay-relevant): Jean Cassegrain on Longchamp's heritage, innovation & Le Pliage success
